text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace said she had some business 
at the shrine, so upon arriving there...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ace-san and Trainer-san. Are you here 
to pray for good health?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Well, I haven't been in the best shape 
lately. But that's the kind of thing I 
wanna sort out myself.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I came here today to give thanks for 
making it this far. To the gods of this 
place.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I used to come say hi like this back home 
all the time too! Ever since I was a 
squirt, really.

text_block_list.name: Young Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Dear God! Thanks for always lookin' out 
for everyone! ...Wait, I mean, thank you 
very much!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And yet, wouldn't it be rude not to 
properly show your face to the gods around 
here?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Etiquette and duty... I see. Um, would you 
mind if I joined you as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After everyone finished making their 
shrine visit, a mysterious gust of wind 
blew past.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? ...Did someone just say something to 
me...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ? No, it's nothing. However—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh, maybe it was a god. Like one that 
called out to Ace.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The deity enshrined here is revered across 
many regions as a tutelary god. Perhaps 
even at the shrine in your hometown, 
Ace-san...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So you mean they might not just be the 
same person, but the same deity? If that's 
true, we ought to be thankful.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you once again for everything. 
Please continue looking after everyone 
back home as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Above all else... seeing that posture must 
have moved even the gods, wouldn't you 
say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, curiously enough, Katsuragi 
Ace's slump was cured right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Katsuragi Ace muttered that, a 
torrential downpour began to fall!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aha... Guess that's a wake-up call from 
God. Telling me I'm still not trying hard 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace brushed it off cheerfully, 
but her slump continued unabated...
